_about: The names of nextasks 0.8.0 in /openapi.json (branch konten), taken with einst-werkzeug/openapi-namen; E53: they stay.

GET /api/about/updates.summary: Whether a newer nextasks is out (asked once a day)

POST /api/app/1/batch.summary: Changes, in order; each answered on its own

POST /api/me/whats-new/seen.summary: "What's new" of the running version is read or put away

PUT /api/notify/routes.summary: Turn one report or event on one channel on or off

PUT /api/notify/schedules/{report}.summary: When a report comes (in the account's time zone)

GET /api/notify/unsubscribe/{token}.summary: What a link from a mail would turn off (no sign-in needed)

PUT /api/oidc/admin/providers/order.summary: Put the providers in this order (the drag handle)

PUT /api/oidc/admin/providers/{provider_.summary: Save a provider; another issuer drops its links

GET /api/oidc/authentik/address.summary: What the authentik card shows about the public address

GET /api/oidc/authentik/blueprint.summary: Download a blueprint that creates the same objects in authentik

GET /api/oidc/callback.summary: The return from the provider of the entry oidc (the address before the list)

GET /api/oidc/me.summary: The active providers and whether the own account is linked to each

DELETE /api/oidc/me/address.summary: Do not offer the provider's address any more

GET /api/oidc/providers.summary: The active sign-in providers: slug and label (no sign-in needed)

GET /api/oidc/{slug}/start.summary: Send the browser to the provider (no sign-in needed)

GET /api/v1/dashboard.summary: The numbers and the soonest tasks for a dashboard card
